_meta.note: The three-tier container set (scope doc §10.12). Cut as individual PNGs rather than registering two whole spritesheets, because the game needs five frames out of ~1600 and an images-mode sheet preloads every entry it lists. Frames were located VISUALLY on a grid overlay and confirmed against a rendered strip before wiring — see the memory note about contact-sheet picks drifting. Sources: fantasy dungeon.png (51 cols, 16px) col28/row3 + col29/row3 + col32/row4; 32rogues tiles.png (17 cols, 32px) frames 289 + 290. THE SOURCES HAVE DIFFERENT NATIVE SIZES — fantasy is 16px, 32rogues is 32px — and resolveArt returns ONE nativeSize per sheet, so a mixed sheet would draw half of its entries at half scale. The three 16px frames were therefore upscaled 2x NEAREST on extraction, making every entry here a true 32px. Re-extracting any of them means re-applying that upscale, or the piece silently renders small.
